summary: Kyntra Bio filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026 announcing an amended and restated Revenue Interest Financing Agreement with NQ Project Phoebus, L.P. The deal cuts maximum aggregate payments from $125 million to $65 million, a $60 million reduction, eliminating future true-ups. Kyntra paid a $42.6 million accelerated upfront amount, bringing total payments to $50 million, fully returning the investor's capital, with $15 million remaining. Kyntra will pay 50% of European and other ex-Japan Astellas EVRENZO royalties quarterly until the cap is met, after which royalties revert fully. Japan royalties and related collateral are released. Combined with the April 2026 FibroGen Europe bankruptcy, future liabilities fell roughly $80 million. Watch the September 30, 2026 Form 10-Q for the full agreement text and any residual liquidity or royalty-reporting risk.
